style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant rows, fresh outdoor lawn-green #6FA84C scenes, warm off-white #FAF7F2 and light matte board #EFEAE3 for infographic panels, deep charcoal #26262A for the sole detail, one accent red #D8342A closing panel
style.iconSystem: thin-line sport icons, single accent color, low complexity
style.lightingSystem: bright daylight-balanced studio light with a front-left key and soft contact shadows for packshots; sunny morning outdoor light around 5200-5300K with one clear shadow direction for scenes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent energetic casual-sports footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2B2B2B, fresh lawn green #6FA84C and one vivid red accent #D8342A; bright daylight-balanced lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows, outdoor shots in sunny morning light; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin red underline bar motif; consistent thin-line sport icons; clean high-end sneaker photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for packshots with balanced natural margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no lighting drift between variant colorways
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for packshots; shoe always grounded with a contact shadow, never floating; product never covered by props or text
style.surfaceSystem: short fresh lawn grass, light matte studio board, warm off-white infographic board, hard grey pavement for pain-point context
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin red #D8342A underline bar motif, short headlines and labels only
